sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Senpou Temple is a temple in the Mt. Kongo region. It is home to some monks who have been corrupted by their obsession with the undying.
Sculptor's Idols:
- Shugendo
- Temple Grounds
- Main Hall
- Inner Sanctum
- Sunken Valley Cavern
- Bell Demon's Temple

sections.heading: Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo
sections.text:
The elevator from the Bottomless Hole leads to a path to the temple is lined with cliffs and patrolled by Monks.
The voice of the Divine Child warns against those who wish to enter.

sections.heading: Shugendo, Temple Grounds

sections.heading: Halls of Illusion
sections.text:
An illusory world, protected by the Folding Screen Monkeys to hide the Divine Child of Rejuvenation.
There are four notable locations in the area:
- Abyss Hall: "Below is an abyss. The bottom cannot be seen. Above is darkness. Nothing can be seen."
- Deafening Bell: "This bell is deafening. Ringing it recklessly will also make your ears ring."
- Light Hall: "A bare flame in the wind. When it goes out, the place becomes dark as night."
- Roaring Hall: "The noise of the Roaring Waterfall is deafening. Surely no one can hear anything else in here."

sections.heading: Main Hall, Inner Sanctum and Cave
sections.text:
The key building of the temple, which houses the Inner Sanctum, where the Divine Child of Rejuvenation resides.
Next to the Hall is a dark cave where the High Priest of Senpou Temple sits in immortal eternity, petrified and uncaring, surrounded by Lesser Centipedes.
